sent.prompt: The window in [Image1]. Every pane pops out of its frame one by one and drifts down into the garden, leaving the frame empty. The panes settle in a loose scattered pile on the grass, the moon still in one of them. Camera at eye level, still. A woman's voice says: "I saw the moon in my parent's bedroom window the other day. I got it. I took all the pieces off the window and one of them had the moon on it."
